card.name: Connecting words in old-style formal prose
card.fires_on: Small connecting words and verbs inside long sentences, mostly in archaic or 19th-century style prose such as natural history, naval or historical writing. Some hits fall in drug-label sentences, but the old-style prose is the clearest setting.

modes.label: Old-style prose
modes.description: Prepositions, pronouns or verbs partway through a formal historical or natural-history sentence.
